title: Minimum Deletions to Make Array Beautiful
description: Find minimum deletions to make array beautiful: (1) length is even, (2) nums[i] != nums[i+1] for all even i.
pseudocode:
1. deletions = 0
2. i = 0
3. while i < nums.length - 1:
4.   if nums[i] == nums[i + 1]:
5.     deletions++
6.     i++
7.   else:
8.     i += 2
9. if (nums.length - deletions) % 2 != 0:
10.  deletions++

steps.note: Compare nums[0] and nums[1]. They are equal.
Increment deletions because of duplicate pair.
Skip the first element, move i to index 1.
Elements at 1 and 2 are different, move i to 3.
Loop ends as i is no longer less than nums.length - 1.
Check parity: length 4 - 1 deletion = 3 (odd). Need 1 more deletion.
